title: Scene Schema
description: Standardized data model for the smallest unit of narrative execution in Athena OS.

chapter_id.description: The chapter this scene belongs to

goal.description: The POV character's micro-goal for this scene

disaster.description: How the scene ends (usually badly) to drive the plot forward

scene_number.description: Sequential scene number within the chapter (1, 2, 3, ...)

scene_title.description: Brief descriptive title (3-6 words) for the scene header, e.g., "The Interrogation Begins"

prose_content.description: The actual written text of the scene. MUST follow SRV-005 Output Formatting Requirements: (1) Begin with '### Scene [N]: [Title]' header. (2) All dialogue in markdown blockquotes (>) with tags/beats inside. (3) No narrative prose inside dialogue blockquotes.
